messages:
jordan: Heads up — I'm moving from Oakland, CA to Austin, TX. Lease starts 2026-05-01. Quick Qs: do I keep the WFH stipend? Is it prorated for May? Any payroll/tax steps I need to take? zip will change to 78701.

maria (People Ops): Congrats! For the WFH stipend we continue it as long as your primary work location is your home. We do prorate for partial months. Can you file the Location Change form? https://hr.redwood.com/location-change

jordan: Filed the form just now and attached the lease. Moving day is 2026-05-12. Do I need to update W-4/state withholding now? TX has no state income tax — will payroll handle it?

sam (Payroll): @jordan Thanks — payroll will auto-switch state withholding once the address change is processed. We need an effective move date (you gave 2026-05-12) and a copy of the lease (attached). We'll stop CA state withholding from the pay period that includes the effective date.

jordan: Cool. For the stipend: will May be prorated since I move mid-month? How do you calculate proration?

maria (People Ops): Yes, May will be prorated. Policy is calendar-day prorate. Example: $200/mo stipend -> (days eligible in month / days in month) * 200. Since your Austin address is effective 5/12, we'll prorate based on that date.

sam (Payroll): I'll run the math and post the exact amount. Action items for payroll: process address change effective 2026-05-12, prorate WFH stipend for May, update state withholding to TX starting the pay cycle that covers 5/12. I'll confirm by EOD.

alex (Manager): FYI — team is aware, no changes on project assignments. Also check benefits implications if the move changes provider networks. @maria

maria (People Ops): Good call. Moving states can affect network availability for some plans. We'll check benefits enrollment and reach out if any plan changes are needed. Note: Redwood does not automatically provide relocation pay unless preapproved by People Ops.

jordan: One more — does this trigger any tax nexus or require the company to register in TX? I only ask because a couple teammates are thinking about moving there too.

maria (People Ops): Individual moves don't create nexus by themselves. Nexus becomes a company concern when there is a concentration of headcount or sales activity in a state. If more folks move to TX and it becomes a cluster, we'll loop in legal and tax to evaluate. For now, no immediate action on company registration.

sam (Payroll): Summarizing next steps: (1) Payroll to change address effective 2026-05-12, (2) prorate and pay WFH stipend for May, (3) update withholding to TX for subsequent pay cycles, (4) benefits team to verify network eligibility. I'll update this thread when processed.

hr-bot: Reminder — please upload proof of residence (lease or utility bill) within 7 days or stipend disbursement may be delayed.

jordan: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
